players.name: Jeffery Simmons
players.comment: Simmons logged six tackles (three solo), including 2.0 sacks, one forced fumble and one fumble recovery during the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.

players.name: Joey Slye
players.comment: Slye made his only field-goal attempt while going 3-for-3 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

players.name: Joshua Williams
players.comment: The Titans activated Williams (pectoral) from reserve/PUP on Saturday.

players.name: Kevin Winston Jr.
players.comment: Winston (quadriceps) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

players.name: Timmy Horne
players.comment: The Titans signed Horne from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Tommy Townsend
players.comment: Titans head coach Robert Saleh said Monday that Townsend is still being evaluated after sustaining a left knee injury in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

players.name: Tony Adams
players.comment: Adams (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Browns.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.comment: Pollard carried the ball 25 times for 129 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns. He also caught all three of his targets for 26 yards.

players.name: Tyjae Spears
players.injury: Not injury related - resting player, Knee
players.comment: out

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.comment: Robinson caught four of seven targets for seven yards during Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.comment: Coach Dan Quinn noted Monday that with Terry McLaurin (knee) out for the season, Stefon Diggs' workload isn't expected to change much, however others, notably Williams, should see added opportunities in McLaurin's looming absence, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Austin Ekeler
players.comment: Ekeler logged a three-yard carry and caught both of his targets for four yards during the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday.

players.name: Charles Omenihu
players.comment: questionable

players.name: Chig Okonkwo
players.comment: Okonkwo brought in all seven targets for 69 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

players.name: Drew Stevens
players.comment: Stevens made his only field-goal try and converted both of his extra-point attempts during Monday's 23-17 loss at San Francisco.

players.name: Dyami Brown
players.comment: Brown hauled in his only target for six yards during Monday's 23-17 loss versus San Francisco.

players.name: Javon Kinlaw
players.comment: Kinlaw (knee) won't return to Washington's matchup versus the 49ers on Monday, John Keim of ESPN reports.

players.name: Javontae Jean-Baptiste
players.comment: The Commanders placed Jean-Baptiste (pectoral) on injured reserve Monday.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.comment: Daniels completed 29 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding four rushes for 10 yards in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

players.name: Jaylin Lane
players.comment: Lane underwent surgery Oct. 9 to repair his fractured and dislocated ankle, and he is expected to be cleared for activities before OTAs, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.comment: McNichols accrued five rushes for 13 yards during Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

players.name: Jordan Magee
players.comment: The Commanders activated Magee (hamstring) from injured reserve, and he is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

players.name: Marcus Mariota
players.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Mariota (knee) is on track to return to practice this week, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Nick Cross
players.comment: Cross (illness) is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

players.name: Percy Butler
players.comment: Butler (hamstring) is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.comment: White rushed seven times for 27 yards and brought in four of five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 23-17 loss to the 49ers on Monday night.

players.name: Sonny Styles
players.comment: Styles finished Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers with 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass defense.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn announced Monday that McLaurin has been diagnosed with a torn patellar tendon in his left knee following an MRI and will miss the rest of the season.

players.name: Trey Amos
players.comment: Amos (ankle) was activated from injured reserve by Washington on Monday.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.comment: Burks finished with four receptions for 66 yards on six targets in Monday's 23-17 loss to the 49ers.

players.name: Tyler Owens
players.comment: Owens (hamstring) is active for Monday night's game against the 49ers.
